question: Which Indian state has 'KOKBOROK' as one of its official languages?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Kokborok:**

__
 
• It is an **indigenous language** spoken by the people of Tripura and parts of Assam and Bangladesh.
 
• It is a Sino-Tibetan language that dates at least to the first century AD, when Tripuri monarchs' historical records began to be recorded in a book known as the **Rajratnakar.**
 
• **As of January 19, 1979, it was recognized as one of Tripura's official languages.**
 
• The dialect originates from the Sino-Tibetan speech family and is a member of the Tibeto-Burman group of languages.
 
• In 1897, Muslim scholar **Doulot Ahammad** produced the **first Kokborok Grammar**, known as **"KOKBOROMA ANG TRIPURA—VYAKARAN GRAMMAR," **giving Kokborok its written form.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Himachal Pradesh:**

 
• There are many different languages spoken in this multilingual state.
 
• The **official language **of this state is** Hindi.**
 
• **According to the 2011 Census of India**, there are about **32 different languages** that are spoken in this state.
 
• The** most often spoken regional language** in the area is** Pahari, also called Himachali,** and it has multiple dialects.
 
• **Tibetan, Dogri, and Kinnauri** are some of the other significant languages spoken in the state.

**Goa:**

 
• The **official language of Goa is Konkani.**
 
• In Goa, 66.11% of people speak Konkani.
 
• **Marathi** is spoken by most people after Konkani.
 
• Most people who speak Marathi are from north Goa.
 
• **Kannada** is spoken by roughly 5%.

**West Bengal:**

 
• The **official languages** of the state are **Bengali and English.**
 
• Other language spoken in the state are Hindi, **Santali, Urdu, Nepali, and Sadan/Sadri.**
